status: DRAFT (not registered; SPEC_SHA256 None; k_tests, size_check_result, k_block (chg_1d, chg_1w), code_sha256 and every census_fixed value null until the pre-check and the census)
design: docs/research_lab/LIVE_TESTS_11.md (design text frozen: sha256 991100db5d6c75e3f76e3d0d10cc5f957dd755108e09ec05edd8dad0f91b3583 at 3627d7fd, merged 1f353ca6)

experiments.CH234: the dollar weight of a move

dates_comment: proposed fast-lane values of LIVE_TESTS_11.md 1.1; the ordered lane (a lapse) changes the three dates and the module constants together
k_tests_rule: the tests whose census gate passes (section 7), a subset of [CH234, CH233, CH232]; fixed at registration, never changed; a census_dropped test is never re-censused, a census_unavailable (coverage) test may be in the ordered lane as its own Holm family
code_sha_rule: normalised sha256 (SPEC_SHA256 line excluded) of every module in live_tests11.CODE_FILES
f_roles_rule: fixed per test by design (1.9, R1 ruling A4), never by a census count; there is no f_binding key; live_tests11.f_role refuses any other value

eligibility.rule: section 1.4: binary, not closed, active, two-sided (bid > 0, ask < 1, bid < ask) and spread <= 0.10 at k - 1 and k; one row per condition_id

sports_rule: cb17_census.is_sports_sidecar(fee_type, fee_category, series_slugs) on the sidecar of the capture; sidecar missing -> sports = -1 (unknown; excluded wherever the category is needed)

crypto_rule.rule: vendored-only: read by the copied category_cols; LT9 classifies crypto with crypto_classifier (the crypto7 class), never with this rule

series_key_rule: first series slug if present, else 'event:' + event_id; crypto rows without a slug -> 'crypto:noslug'

crypto_classifier.rule: 1.4: every primary excludes crypto by this classifier; unknown is counted separately and treated as crypto; the crypto arm is reported, uncounted
crypto_classifier.failsafe: if no distinct fee_category value of the whole sealed sidecar set contains 'crypto' the classifier is not shown to work and the census is refused (every gate NaN)

move.class_rule: LT3's class and geometry (vendored; read by the copied _movers_join; no LT11 test uses the class: CH234's classes come from volume_num, 2.3)

member_cap.rule: n_members(e, j) = distinct markets of Gamma event e among capture j's complete rows that are binary, open and active (a market without event_id is its own event); CH234 and CH232 keep n_members <= 10 (larger: the reported ladder arm); CH233's member rule is its own (3.2)

rv.rule: LT11 ambiguity A5: the minimum number of observed 2 h changes in the 12-slot window is not stated by the design; LT9 CH212's 10 is used

k_block.rule: 7 / 1.5 (R1 should-fix 6): filled from the committed header pre-check BEFORE the seal; true -> the column enters K as an indicator pair; the seal and every census refuse while null

m1_side_rule: 1.4.2 + the ledger record of the design-text freeze (b057e076): the venue's documented reading (single-sided scores inside [0.10, 0.90] at the reduced weight c = 3.0, double-sided required outside); M1 follows the CHEAP side

seeds.derived_rule: non-binding runs on generators 20261497 x 100 + n (1.8.1)

gates.perm_method: block circular-shift Freedman-Lane (market strata for CH234 and CH232, event-phase strata for CH233)

inference.p_rule: p = max(p_event on t with G_event - 1 df, p_two-way normal, p_day on t with G_day - 1 df); CH232 event df use min(G_event, G_minor) - 1

size_check.rule: a failing binding scenario sets only its own tests to 'SE check failed'; k unchanged; no rerun

census_inputs.lt11_seal_note: written by run_live_tests11.py seal (q0691) after the design-text freeze and after the span has ended; committed before the census
census_inputs.window_rule: captures from 12 slots before the span to 3 slots after it (the three twins' slots k + 1 .. k + 3 of the last origins; the lag-slot loader returns the twin term only)
census_inputs.covered_days_rule: covered origins / 12, a covered origin being a sealed slot whose capture and the capture of the slot before it are both state=complete with rows and sidecar present; for twin pairs also the captures of slots k + 2 and k + 3; from the seal manifest, before any row is read; identical for all three tests
census_inputs.projection: counts x 21 / covered days; distinct-event gates use the UNPROJECTED count over the covered days

mde_common.rule: every MDE gate is max(declared, design) (7); declared = the closed formula at the census's own effective counts, DE_gate, VIF_w (and gap) with the declared SD; design = 3.47 x 1.5 x SD x se_1 under a working covariance (unit variance, within-event equicorrelation 0.02, independence across events), projected to 21 days; F-MDE = max(design-based MDE of Delta in the arm model, MDE x sqrt(2 / (1 - max(0, r_gate)))); NaN fails; DE_gate = max(floor, 1 + (m_21 - 1) x 0.02); t_sum = max(3.47, exact)

census_fixed_rule: filled with the exact census floats (8.4 step 5); mde_c = the census slope MDE (CH234, CH233) or class MDE (CH232) in cents, the input of 1.9's 'underpowered' label only (never a gate or verdict); exclude_family is "" when no family was excluded
informed_labels_rule: 1.1 / 1.6 / 1.9: the 'informed (X)' labels each test carries by the registration record (e.g. 'E015' for CH234 if the census output or the lapse is after T_E015); filled at the pin from the ledger; never removable; never a verdict

economics.hurdles: cost-model-v1 (COST_MODEL.md), reported in the analysis; never a verdict
